basic_profile.bio: I'm a second-year undergraduate student at the University of Chicago, majoring in Political Science with a keen interest in economic systems and their historical development. Born and raised in the Midwest, I decided to attend UChicago for its rigorous academic environment and unique course offerings. Outside of my studies, I enjoy gaming, particularly eSports, and I'm an avid supporter of the Fnatic team. My interests also extend to Korean manhwa, which I find to be a fascinating blend of art and storytelling. I usually browse Reddit during the evening hours, after classes and study sessions. Currently, I'm single and focusing on balancing my academic and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a Political Science major at UChicago, I have developed a solid foundation in economic theories and political systems. My coursework has included a variety of perspectives on capitalism, which I regularly discuss with fellow students and professors. I also keep abreast of global economic trends through online articles and discussions on Reddit.
